name: Omaquota
author: Neil Patel
description: TUI-style dashboard for a remote CLIProxyAPI: proxy-wide usage stats and the remaining quota of every subscription behind it.

barWidget.description: Requests, tokens, latency and top models for the proxy, then every Claude / Codex / xAI subscription with its usage windows and time to reset.

schema.label: Host label shown in the panel
Per-account quota refresh (seconds)
schema.description: Quota lookups hit each provider's own API through the proxy; keep this gentle or Anthropic rate-limits the account.

schema.label: Number shown in the bar (last 24h)
schema.description: tokens = new input + output; tokens-split = ↑new input ↓output; requests; cost = estimated spend; none = icon only. Cache reads are left out of the bar (they re-send the whole conversation every turn) and shown in the tooltip.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: A name (server-network, server, lan, network, gauge, gauge-fa, speedometer, meter, pulse, waveform, signal, chart, chart-line, trending, counter, abacus, coins, cash, usd, fuel, brain, robot, chip, flash, timer) or any Nerd Font glyph.
